question: Does there exist a small R33-lean nonterminal CNF for which every bipolar pivot fails exact-DP post-subsumption clause descent, i.e. |T_v| >= |F| for all variables v?

search.formula_family: canonical random 3-CNF over n in {5,6,7} with distinct variables per clause
filters: R33 performs zero reductions and leaves formula unchanged
every variable occurs in both polarities

survivor_followup: record selected macro decomposition if any

interpretation.FOUND_SURVIVOR: finite explicit counterexample to universal direct post-subsumption DP descent only; not a counterexample to TRUMP universal coverage
interpretation.NO_SURVIVOR_WITHIN_BUDGET: finite negative search result only; cannot elevate to a universal theorem
